full_page.content:
Pg. 22 Handwritten notes Retreat October 11 - 15th 1937 ( in Detroit) (Z V. Rev. Theodosius Foley, Provincial)
I. Renewal of the Franciscan Spirit.
II. Venite .. Discite a me quia mitis sum · et humilis corde."
III, IV. .... Simplicity .... unworldness.
Charity .... Deus Caritas est et qui manet in Caritate in Deo manet et Deus in eo. . Impressive - Beautiful.
Fraternal Charity ... "If a mother loves her son according to the flesh how much more diligently ought every one to love him who is his brother according to the spirit.
WHY DID GOD MAKE YOU 2nd Q. in the old Catechism.
God made me to know Him. O what a bles'd aim! To love Him and serve Him sure Rests in the same.
It's Heaven begun, for the grateful, on Earth. To treasure aright !?!?!!!!!! Highest Heaven its worth. Fr. Sol.
Pg. 23 Handwritten notes 1938 Retreat - October 23 (Fr. Edmund) in St. Felix Monastery
To live according to the Holy Gospel
24 th
I. Appreciation - Gratitude for vocation - "You have not chosen me but I have chosen you".
II. The talents lent us to use. . . Vocation ...
III. Watch and pray ... Be ready always. .. Death
25th (68 To-day .... Deo Gratias!)
I. Passion of Jesus - Supreme proof of His Love.
II. Poverty, Foundation and Queen of Seraphic Perfection.
III. Obedience Better Than Sacrifice Surest way to please God.
IV. Chastity - Angelic Virtue demands sacrifice. Temptations against it not necessarily sinful ....
